Ecografia ostetrica (2/3): misura la tes: Obstetric ultrasound (2/3): measure the fetal head
Ecografia ostetrica di routine. Immagine: Routine obstetric ultrasound. Axial image of the fetal head. Date of last menstrual period not available.
Misura la circonferenza cranica con gli: Measure the head circumference with the viewer tools and estimate the gestational age.
La circonferenza cranica (CC) si misura:
Head circumference (HC) is measured on an axial plane of the head: a regular, symmetric oval, continuous midline echo interrupted anteriorly by the cavum septi pellucidi, thalami visible, cerebellum not visible (if the cerebellum is seen the plane is too low and tilted). The ellipse is placed on the outer edge of the skull.
In the first trimester gestational age is dated with the crown-rump length; in the second trimester HC is a good dating parameter. In the third trimester variability between fetuses increases: HC is used to follow growth, not to date the pregnancy (the first-trimester dating is used).
Ellisse sul bordo esterno della teca, su: Ellipse on the outer skull edge, on the plane with the midline and cavum septi pellucidi.
Collezione HC18: circonferenza cranica d: HC18 collection: reference head circumference 172.0 mm (experienced sonographer). Hadlock: about 19.8 weeks.
L'immagine è adatta alla misura?: Is the image suitable for measurement?

Piano assiale della testa adatto: contor: Suitable axial plane of the head: complete oval skull outline and visible midline

Il cervelletto non si vede; la struttura: The cerebellum is not seen; the bright posterior structure is the choroid plexus.
Con il righello misura il diametro bipar: With the ruler measure the biparietal diameter (outer to outer edge of the skull) and the occipitofrontal diameter; the circumference is about 1.57 × (BPD + OFD). With an ellipse you measure directly along the outer skull edge.
